items.title: Scaling up biobased chemicals made from ethanol
items.summary: At this year's Bio Innovations Midwest in Omaha on September 24-25, 2024 , Noah Helman, Founder & CEO of iMicrobes, shared exciting insights into how ethanol—commonly known as a fuel and ingredient in beer—can also be the best renewable feedstock for chemical production.

items.title: How to design a biomanufacturing process for success
items.summary: Many bio-based chemical processes struggle to scale—because they don’t achieve cost parity. This article explores how strategic feedstock selection and simplified purification can enable bio-based chemicals, like acrylic acid, to compete with petrochemical routes on both cost and performance.

items.title: iMicrobes produces 100% bio-based acrylic acid through its scaled-up bioprocess
items.summary: Industrial Microbes (iMicrobes) has successfully scaled up production of 100% bio-based, high-purity acrylic acid using advanced fermentation. Backed by BioMADE, this milestone proves the economics and scalability of sustainable chemical manufacturing.
